$comment: Label definitions for hagelien/kinetix. Applied by .github/workflows/label-sync.yml (and `npm run labels:sync`) with `gh label create --force`, which creates a missing label and updates the colour/description of one that already exists. Nothing here ever deletes a label, so labels that are not listed are left alone. P0-P3 are urgency bands for any issue, review-born or not: the same four bands docs/REVIEW_POLICY.md routes review findings into, so the two never drift into separate vocabularies, but the descriptions stay source-neutral because most labelled issues have no raising pull request. What a review finding of each severity obliges is in docs/REVIEW_POLICY.md; `review-debt` is what marks an issue as review-born. .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/review-debt.md names `P2` and `review-debt`, which a template silently drops if they do not exist, so both have to be declared here. `immediate_implementation` is the one label a human applies to make something happen rather than to describe it: labelling an issue with it wakes the issue-worker routine, which implements that issue straight away instead of waiting for the next scheduled backlog pass.

labels.name: P0
labels.description: Highest urgency: blocks a release. Takes priority over all other work.

labels.name: P1
labels.description: High urgency: worked immediately, ahead of planned backlog work.

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Real but not blocking. Tracked as scheduled work, never dropped.

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Lowest urgency. Tracked like a P2, picked up when it fits.

labels.name: review-debt
labels.description: Deferred review finding awaiting the milestone backlog review.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on another issue, a decision, or an external dependency.

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Umbrella issue tracking a set of subtasks.

labels.name: subtask
labels.description: Part of an epic; see the parent issue for the whole picture.

labels.name: auto-fix
labels.description: Filed automatically from a failed build or a runtime error.

labels.name: immediate_implementation
labels.description: Work this issue now: wakes the issue worker to implement it straight away.
